mathematical_audit.clearing_recurrence: Multiplying the nth partial sum by (B)_n gives Q_n=(B+n-1)Q_(n-1)+d_n exactly. The four Item364 periods use the stated A,B and terminal cutoffs, and all actual denominators are p-units.
mathematical_audit.target_line: For L_h=6s+4h+3, Res(L_h,P)=6^deg(P) P(sigma_h). Every discrepancy between the resultant and the reduced phase numerator is supported on primes at most 4h+3, while every actual p is at least 4h+9. The saturated large-prime supports therefore agree exactly.
mathematical_audit.whipple_rectangle: Direct coefficient extraction gives the terminating very-well-poised 4F3 rectangle. Whipple's finite identity evaluates the two crossed entries as the displayed Pochhammer ratios, whose cleared factors are all nonzero and smaller than every actual p when 3 does not divide h.
mathematical_audit.contiguity: The actual and matched parameter points differ by (10h+3)/6, whose fractional part is 1/6 or 5/6 on potentially prime rays. Finite classical contiguous chains make only integral parameter shifts and cannot connect these points.
mathematical_audit.k0_rank: The nonzero coefficients (A)_t span the denominator functions 1/(B)_t. After multiplying by (B)_h these become monic polynomials of all degrees h through zero, proving exact state rank h+1.
mathematical_audit.k1_rank: The interior K1 coefficient is a nonzero quartic in its degree index after nonvanishing factors are removed. At most four coefficients of either parity disappear, giving ranks at least h-3 and h-4; boundary coefficients can only increase them.
mathematical_audit.method_barrier: Ordinary resultants have O(h^2 log h) height, while tied-line carriers improve only to O(h log h). Even after deleting all primes at most 4h+3, the order-one comparison product carries M/8+o(M) Chebyshev mass, so generic recurrence/height/resultant/divisor-sieve arguments cannot prove zero rate.
mathematical_audit.scope: The theorem does not classify exact-zero phase pairs or prove weighted divisibility for the nonzero primitive carriers. The shared fixed-j1 ceiling remains 1/36.
